# 📂 .github

[![Open FUNDING.yml](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open-FUNDING.yml-blue)](FUNDING.yml)

Contains GitHub funding settings and CI automation. See the [project introduction](../README.md).

GitHub uses the funding configuration here to populate the Sponsor button. Open workflows for job definitions or scripts for the commands they invoke.
